artboards.title: Command center — the app tells you where to go
Category page — Getting found on Google

annotations.text: HOME = the nav. One card per category with the one number that matters, better/worse arrow, and how many suggestions wait. The alerts on top are the AI speaking first — you never have to notice a problem yourself.
Every category page has this same skeleton: plain-words title, status light, 3-5 numbers, then the suggestion queue. Max 7 suggestions per week, ranked Fix now / Worth doing / Nice to have.

Every card, same 3 buttons, same order, always visible: Approve (green), Regenerate (redo the wording), Ignore (stop suggesting this). Delete hides in the "..." menu. Nothing touches your site until you hit Approve.
Handled cards collapse to a receipt line and the app checks the fix actually went live. Done tab keeps every receipt.
